definitions.explanation: a person who easily becomes embarrassed or self-conscious, especially in social situations

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や}だ。
{恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や}なので、{人前|ひとまえ}で{話|はな}すのが{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: I'm shy, so I'm not good at speaking in front of people.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}は{恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や}だったが、{今|いま}は{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: I was shy as a child, but I'm different now.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
- {恥|は}ずかしい (embarrassed, shy) + がる (to show signs of) + {屋|や} (person who tends to be)

PERSONALITY SUFFIX -{屋|や}:
This suffix creates personality types:
- {寂|さび}しがり{屋|や} (person who gets lonely easily)
- {怖|こわ}がり{屋|や} (scaredy-cat)
- {甘|あま}えん{坊|ぼう} (pampered person)

RELATED:
- {内気|うちき} (introverted, reserved)
- {引|ひ}っ{込|こ}み{思案|じあん} (hesitant, diffident)
- {人見知|ひとみし}り (shy around strangers)
